metadata.description: Goldfish QP, Quick Peek for forgetful humans: click an object, abbreviation or identifier in Claude's reply to see its definition from your own sources, with no LLM call. A fork of Quick Peek from midudev/better-claude.

plugins.name: goldfish-qp
plugins.description: Click an object, abbreviation or identifier in Claude's reply to see its definition from your own JSON and Markdown sources, with freshness and no LLM call. Also previews the paths Claude mentions.
